detailed_descriptions.en: You don’t just survive. You lead. In a world destroyed by a failed cure, survival is no longer enough. Build your own colony, recruit survivors, and take control of their lives. Decide who works, who fights, and who earns their place in your camp. In this new world, the dead are not your only threat. Other survivors want what you have — and they won’t ask twice. 🟠 FOUND AND LEAD YOUR OWN COLONY Start with nothing. Build something that lasts. Create and develop your own colony in a dangerous open world. Recruit survivors, assign roles, and shape your group based on your decisions. Will you build a loyal community — or rule through fear? Defend your colony, expand your influence, and prove your leadership. 🟡 CAMP LIFE AND CONTROL Your colony lives or dies by your decisions. Assign tasks such as farming, resource gathering, and animal care. Manage hunger, sleep, and psychological states to keep your people functional. Every survivor has a role. Every decision has consequences. 🔵 ACTION-FUELED BATTLES Survival alone is not enough. You must fight for control. Engage in combat against the undead and rival colonies. Lead assaults, defend your territory, and take over enemy camps. Recruit the survivors you defeat — or eliminate them. 🟣 OPEN WORLD AND FREEDOM Explore a dangerous, living world. Roam freely across a large city filled with threats, opportunities, and hidden resources. Follow the story — or create your own path. The world reacts to your actions. ⚫ KEY FEATURES A vast 6 km² open world city Colony building and management Recruit and control survivors Task assignment and resource systems Hunger, sleep, and psychological mechanics AI-driven characters with dynamic behavior Enemy colonies to conquer FPS and TPS gameplay options Day-night cycle and dynamic weather Four seasons affecting gameplay Vehicles for exploration and transport Reputation and trust systems Alliances with other colonies Story-driven and sandbox gameplay options

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
You don’t just survive. You lead.

In a world destroyed by a failed cure, survival is no longer enough.
Build your own colony, recruit survivors, and take control of their lives.

Decide who works, who fights, and who earns their place in your camp.

In this new world, the dead are not your only threat.
Other survivors want what you have — and they won’t ask twice.

🟠 FOUND AND LEAD YOUR OWN COLONY

Start with nothing. Build something that lasts.

Create and develop your own colony in a dangerous open world.
Recruit survivors, assign roles, and shape your group based on your decisions.

Will you build a loyal community — or rule through fear?

Defend your colony, expand your influence, and prove your leadership.

🟡 CAMP LIFE AND CONTROL

Your colony lives or dies by your decisions.

Assign tasks such as farming, resource gathering, and animal care.
Manage hunger, sleep, and psychological states to keep your people functional.

Every survivor has a role.
Every decision has consequences.

🔵 ACTION-FUELED BATTLES

Survival alone is not enough. You must fight for control.

Engage in combat against the undead and rival colonies. 
Lead assaults, defend your territory, and take over enemy camps.

Recruit the survivors you defeat — or eliminate them.

🟣 OPEN WORLD AND FREEDOM

Explore a dangerous, living world.

Roam freely across a large city filled with threats, opportunities, and hidden resources.
Follow the story — or create your own path.

The world reacts to your actions.

⚫ KEY FEATURES

  • A vast 6 km² open world city

  • Colony building and management

  • Recruit and control survivors

  • Task assignment and resource systems

  • Hunger, sleep, and psychological mechanics

  • AI-driven characters with dynamic behavior

  • Enemy colonies to conquer

  • FPS and TPS gameplay options

  • Day-night cycle and dynamic weather

  • Four seasons affecting gameplay

  • Vehicles for exploration and transport

  • Reputation and trust systems

  • Alliances with other colonies

  • Story-driven and sandbox gameplay options
